measures.title: Mental Health Recovery Board Serving Warren and Clinton Counties – Proposed Tax Levy (Renewal)
measures.summary: Renews a property tax of up to 1 mill for five years for the current expenses of the Mental Health Recovery Board Serving Warren and Clinton Counties. The county auditor estimates it will collect $7,677,198 a year, which amounts to $16 for each $100,000 of the auditor's market value. Collection would start in 2027, first due in 2028.
measures.yesMeans: The 1-mill mental health recovery levy is renewed for five years.

measures.title: Warren County – Proposed Tax Levy (Renewal): Senior Citizens Services
measures.summary: Renews a Warren County property tax of up to 1.21 mills for five years to provide or maintain senior citizens services. The county auditor estimates it will collect $9,016,446 a year, which amounts to $22 for each $100,000 of the auditor's market value. Collection would start in 2026, first due in 2027.
measures.yesMeans: The 1.21-mill senior services levy is renewed for five years.
